text:
maria (partnerships): Quick sync — EdgeSilicon wants to package OpenArbor-7B into their SI appliance + list a hosted offer in their cloud marketplace. Need clarity on redistribution vs hosted-only, and how we handle co-announcement cadence.
jamal (bd): love it. Do they want downloads included in the SI bundle or just a hosted endpoint we serve?
maria (partnerships): Their SI team needs downloadable quantized weights (4-bit) for on-device inference, but marketing wants a hosted managed tier in their marketplace too. So mixed model.
sara-legal: Important: we need to check OpenArbor upstream license (their fork has dual-licensing notes). If redistribution allowed, we still need attribution + export screening. Can you share upstream link?
maria (partnerships): https://repo.openarbor.ai/OpenArbor-7B-v1 : they use a permissive license but added a redistribution addendum in v1.2 that asks for provenance metadata and no rebranding.
kevin-eng: engineering note — shipping quantized weights to SI means we must vet the quantization pipeline and provide reproducible artifacts. Also need a small compatibility shim for EdgeSilicon kernels (they use custom int8/4 kernels).
ryan-ops: ops: on-prem downloads mean we surface a signed artifact + checksum + SLSA-style provenance. We can gate downloads via a partner agreement and SSO. Need to clarify who signs the distro.
liz-marketing: co-announcement ask: EdgeSilicon wants a joint press release and marketplace launch the same week. Marketing needs 3 weeks lead time for assets and embargo alignment. Also need logo/boilerplate approvals.
sara-legal: On the redistribution side I propose two allowed paths: (1) "Hosted + Managed" — Redwood + EdgeSilicon offer hosted endpoints from our infra; (2) "SI Download" — downloadable quantized weights to certified SI customers under a redistribution addendum with provenance, attribution, and a limited usage warranty. No third-party resell without approval.
jamal (bd): That aligns with EdgeSilicon's ask. They'll accept downloads for named SI engagements if we keep geoblocking and reseller controls. They also asked about co-branding on the marketplace SKU.
kevin-eng: Implementation checklist from runtime side: 
```
- produce signed quantized weight tarball (.tar.gz + sha256)
- provide model card + conversion script (hf -> edge-quant)
- CI job that re-creates quant and verifies logits on sample inputs
- compatibility shim for EdgeSilicon runtime (link to repo)
```
maria (partnerships): Sara — what export controls are we likely to hit? EdgeSilicon has APAC customers.
sara-legal: OpenArbor upstream flagged dual-use concerns for some tokenizer pipelines. We'll run export classification. For downloads to APAC, recommend geoblock until legal clears. Hosted endpoints can be region-restricted with fewer hurdles.
ryan-ops: Ops can do region restrict + partner entitlement flags in the marketplace SKU. For hosted-managed we can offer two SKUs: "EdgeSilicon Hosted (global)" and "EdgeSilicon Hosted (restricted)".
liz-marketing: For announcement timing: tentatively T-21 days for materials, T-7 for embargo signoff, launch window T+0 on Wed. If legal needs geoblock, marketing will adjust PR language.
jamal (bd): Commercial terms: propose revenue split on hosted API calls; fixed fee + per-download license for SI installs. EdgeSilicon expects a higher revenue share on the hosted SKU since they drive marketplace traffic.
sara-legal: I'll draft a redistribution addendum template: attribution clause, provenance header requirements, expiry on offline redistribution (12 months without renewal), and a clause requiring security patch sync cadence.
kevin-eng: One more: we should provide a small test harness for SI integrators that exercises KV caching and warm-start to avoid cold-start surprises on the appliance.
maria (partnerships): Action items: 
- sara-legal: draft addendum + export check (due EOD Thu)
- kevin-eng: quant pipeline docs + CI artifacts (PR by next Tue)
- ryan-ops: SKU config + geoblock implementation plan (runbook) (due next Wed)
- liz-marketing: announce timeline & asset checklist (draft in 3 days)
- jamal: commercial term proposal to EdgeSilicon (sync Friday)
devrel-bot: Reminder: create a partner repo stub under org/redwood-partners/edge-silicon-openarbor with initial README and integration checklist.
maria (partnerships): Also: request from EdgeSilicon — include a small privacy-preserving telemetry opt-in for model performance signals. Early thoughts?
sara-legal: Telemetry must be opt-in and PII-free. We'll need a data processing addendum + DSAR handling in the contract.
kevin-eng: We can emit hashed input-level telemetry (bucketed latencies & token counts) and a fingerprint of prompt shape. No raw prompts. Implementation doable as an opt-in flag in runtime.
jamal (bd): EdgeSilicon loves that approach. They want a short blurb for customers: "privacy-first telemetry, opt-in, aggregated signals only."
maria (partnerships): Great — I'll compile and update EdgeSilicon. Any blockers?
liz-marketing: If legal and ops are OK with geoblock & telemetry wording, marketing can start asset work tomorrow.
sara-legal: No blockers from legal to start drafting.
ryan-ops: Ops will prototype the entitlement + geoblock flow against marketplace staging this week.
maria (partnerships): Perfect — thanks all. We'll reconvene Friday after jamal's commercial sync. :rocket:
